O visor da aplicación é o dun navegador: The app's viewer is a browser's (Chromium), which only reads a few formats, mainly MP4 and WebM. It can't read AVI or MKV, nor many codecs (DV from miniDV tapes, Xvid, MJPEG…). So the trasno prepares a temporary copy just for viewing: if the video is already H.264 with AAC or MP3, only the container changes (in seconds, lossless); otherwise it re-encodes at the same resolution and very high quality, starting with the first 30 seconds so you can watch right away. The original file is never touched and exporting always starts from it.
